entries.heading: The Department of State, Foreign Operations, and
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 21006.  The Department of State, Foreign Operations, and 
Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2020 (division G of Public Law 116-
94) is amended under the heading ``Millennium 
Challenge Corporation'' in title III by striking `` $105,000,000'' in 
the first proviso and inserting in lieu thereof `` $107,000,000''.

[[Page 134 STAT. 592]]
